remarks: Move right into this spacious home that just completed a remodel and is waiting for a new owner! The stunning new kitchen, open to family room and dining area creates the perfect hub for everyday living and entertaining. The inviting living room with fireplace is the ideal setting for cold weather days. The remodel includes renovations to primary bath, family bath and powder room, central air conditioning installed, new driveway, and full interior painted. (See full list of renovations at house).  Darien's largest park, Sellecks Woods is located just steps away giving easy access to nature trails and outdoor exploration. Convenient to shopping and more, yet ideally situated on a cul-de-sac.
